text:
Ellie W.: quick question should required fields use an asterisk or a visible label? i prototyped both. Jon K: asterisk ok visually but not sufficient alone. add sr-only 'required' text after label for a11y. Maya R: inline validation on blur feels useful for name/email, but for multi-step forms maybe only validate on submit. otherwise users get overwhelmed. :face_with_raised_eyebrow: Samir Patel: agree. proposal: inline-on-blur for critical fields + submit summary for remaining. show summary as a compact banner with "N problems 1 expand" so mobile vertical space is preserved. Toni M: accessibility: when the summary appears on submit, move focus to it and use aria-live="assertive". errors should have aria-describedby pointing to the error text. sample: ```
Enter a valid email.
``` Ellie W.: thanks. another bit: destructive action in the form (remove billing info) should we do typed confirm or undo? support reported 2 accidental removals. Jon K: small destructive = inline confirm + undo snackbar. irreversible = modal with typed name. make copy explicit about consequences. Maya R: microcopy suggestion for modal title: "Delete billing profile" and body: "This will permanently remove billing history and cannot be undone. Type the profile name to confirm." keep button label "Delete permanently" not just "Delete". Samir Patel: i'll make two prototypes: (A) inline+banner summary, (B) inline-only with optimistic save+undo, (C) submit-summary modal-heavy. will include copy options and accessibility checklist. design-bot: created doc https://redwood/designs/form-validation-decision please react with preferred variant.
